name: Kubiwa Gakkyuu Boku wa Osananajimi-sama no Shimobe Desu
original_name: くびわ学級 ボクは幼なじみ様のしもべです
source:
The protagonist, Yuuta, is a somewhat timid boy.
The story begins when he accidentally licks the recorder left behind by Hinagiku, the girl he has a crush on.

His actions are witnessed by Nogiku, Hinagiku’s mischievous younger sister and classmate, who even takes a photo of him in the act.
From that day on, he’s blackmailed into becoming her personal slave…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006679.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公岛优太是个有些胆小的少年。
故事始于他偶然舔了暗恋对象出水雏菊遗落的竖笛。

雏菊爱恶作剧的妹妹兼同班同学野菊目睹了他的行为，甚至拍下现场照片。
从那天起，优太便遭到威胁，被迫成为她的专属奴仆……
